examples.title: Example 1: Setting the Display Time Format
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the display time using useMilitaryTime, dateTimeOptions, and format.

examples.title: Example 2: Customizing the Style
examples.description: In this example, disappearTextStyle, textStyle, selectedTextStyle, acceptButtonStyle, and cancelButtonStyle are configured to customize the text and button style.

examples.title: Example 3: Configuring a Dialog Box in the Hover State
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the layout area of a dialog box in hover mode on a foldable device.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting the Dialog Box Position
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the position of a dialog box using alignment and offset.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting the Mask Area
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the mask area using maskRect.

examples.title: Example 6: Setting the Background
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the dialog box background using maskRect.

examples.title: Example 7: Setting the Start Time
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the start time for the time picker dialog box.

examples.title: Example 8: Setting the End Time
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the end time for the time picker dialog box.

examples.title: Example 9: Enabling the AM/PM Indicator to Automatically Switch Based on the Hour Value in 12-hour Format
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to enable the AM/PM indicator to automatically switch based on the hour value in 12-hour format using enableCascade.

examples.title: Example 10: Customizing the Background Blur Effect
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to customize the background blur effect by configuring backgroundBlurStyleOptions. This functionality is supported since API version 19.

examples.title: Example 11: Customizing the Background Effect
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to customize the background effect by configuring backgroundEffect. This functionality is supported since API version 19.
